assertion.statement: The release note states only that cert-manager now takes its golang.org/x/crypto/acme dependency from a local fork of that package, with no change type, exposure condition, or operational effect stated.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: the note only states that the package is now taken from a local fork; it names no typed change (no value, default, requirement, removal, or behavior difference) and gives no literal before/after values; applicability: the fork is internal to cert-manager's own code; no customer-facing input (values key, resource field, flag, image tag, or version) selects or shields it, so no exposure condition can be expressed; consequence: the note describes no functional or operational effect of switching to the local fork; it does not say what fails, changes, or must be done
